_note: One entry per session, keyed by session name (or bare role; the prefix is added). model and effort are what the cockpit shows and the autopilot uses when it relaunches; window is the context window in tokens (200000 or 1000000); launch is the flags a fresh launch gets in the role's pane; role is one line on what the session is for; template is the file in templates/roles/ its prompt starts from; writes is its folders.

agent-lead.role: Sets order and priorities, lands reviewed patches, keeps the owner's decisions

agent-coordinator.role: First point of contact; keeps the board and the panel in order

agent-reviewer.role: Reviews frozen patches, answers GO or HOLD
